messages:
riley: Hey all 3 just joined today and running into a couple onboarding bumps. 1) MDM on my personal Mac shows 'Unable to verify manifest' during install. 2) VPN connects but I can't reach the internal package repo (403). 3) I got a phish-sim invite but no idea when the window is. 4) I need short-lived KMS read for a demo later today. Who do I ping for each?

people-ops: Welcome @riley :tada: Tagging IT and Security. Also if you want a company laptop instead of BYOD we can queue one.

it-support: Hi Riley 1 For the 'Unable to verify manifest' error try this flow: 1) System Settings -> Profiles -> remove any existing redwood profiles; 2) download the mobileconfig again; 3) run `sudo profiles install -F ~/Downloads/redwood-mdm.mobileconfig`. If it still errors run `log show --predicate 'subsystem CONTAINS \"mdm\"' --last 30m | tail -n 60` and paste output here.

morgan-security: Phish-sim runs for 14 days from the invite date and sends 2 reminders; emails come from training@phishsim.io (subject starts with \"Redwood Security Training\"). If you don't see it check spam and add that sender to allow-list. For short-lived KMS read we can issue ephemeral creds via Dev Portal while a key-request is reviewed 1 Submit the key-request form: https://redwood.example/internal/key-requests and paste the request ID here to expedite.

riley: Thanks 3 quick follow-ups: a) I removed old profiles and reinstalled but installer now fails with \"Manifest signing mismatch\". b) VPN shows connected but `curl -I https://packages.internal.redwood` returns 403. c) I filed KR-5599 for demo scope `kms:read:staging` with manager note.

it-support: \"Manifest signing mismatch\" usually means an old cert or partially applied profile. Try installing the CA to System keychain first: download from https://redwood.example/internal/ca and add to System keychain, then re-run installer. If manual steps fail, we'll remote in. For the 403 try: 1) sign into Okta web and approve device; 2) reconnect VPN; 3) test `ssh riley@staging-jump.redwood.internal` to validate routes without touching prod. If that still fails paste `netstat -rn`.

morgan-security: Got KR-5599, marking expedite. While review completes we'll provision ephemeral kms:read for 2 hours via devtools and DM you the creds. Note: FileVault required if you will store prod secrets locally; for staging-only BYOD we accept the BYOD attestation (simple 3-line template) plus the BYOD form.

people-ops: If you want a company laptop, reply here and we'll start provisioning; facilities pickup is usually same-day if stock exists.

riley: Please provision a company laptop 3 prefer not to mess with BYOD at first. Also CA install fixed the manifest step 3 installer completed after reboot. Thanks!! Any ETA on the ephemeral creds?

morgan-security: Ephemeral creds sent to your email (check spam) 1 You should have a 2-hour kms:read token in ~5m. We'll finish the KR review by EOD.

it-support: For the package repo 403 we pushed a missing ACL for your Okta user; try again and if it still 403 paste `curl -I https://packages.internal.redwood`. If you still see issues we can open a temporary route.

security-bot: Reminder: Complete SEC101 onboarding within 7 days: https://learn.redwood.ai/courses/sec101. Phish-sim FAQ: https://redwood.example/internal/phishsim-faq.

facilities: Noted on laptop request 3 we'll provision and DM pickup details when ready. Welcome aboard!

riley: All good 3 installer success, ephemeral creds arrived, and packages access now works after reconnect. Appreciate the quick help everyone :raised_hands:
